name: greyiq
description: GreyIQ local-first AI chat UI with editable bots, personal preference training, an Ollama/Claude/OpenAI coding brain with out-of-the-box GPU acceleration (NVIDIA bundled, AMD auto-provisioned), and a browser CPU/WebGPU fallback.
author: GreyNOC

scripts.build:linux: pyinstaller --noconfirm --clean build/greyiq-backend.spec && chmod +x build/greyiq-cli && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.check:js: node --check server.mjs && node --check public/app.js && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/health.cjs && node --check electron/ollama-runtime.cjs && node --check electron/runtime-path.cjs && node --test electron/health.test.cjs electron/ollama-runtime.test.cjs electron/runtime-path.test.cjs scripts/frontend-dom.test.cjs
scripts.check:python: python -B -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('backend/greyiq_api.py'); compile(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), str(p), 'exec')" && python -B -m pytest -q backend
scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:python && npm run check:devops
